551928_6494f0f4.text: Orexin A and B (or hypocretin-1 and hypocretin-2) are a pair of neuropeptides expressed in a specific population of neurons in the lateral hypothalamic area (LHA) (Sakurai et al., 1998)(Lecea et al., 1998)

551928_8fa3fdef.text: .Orexin neurons project throughout the brain and densely innervate monoaminergic nuclei, including the dorsal raphe nucleus (DR), locus coeruleus (LC) and tuberomammillary nucleus (TMN) (Sakurai et al., 1998)(Nambu et al., 1999)(Peyron et al., 1998)

551928_0c262eb8.text: .These findings indicate that the orexin system plays a crucial role in the regulation of sleep/wakefulness, especially in the maintenance of arousal.
